Articles

Tutorials

Practical guides to estimating and visualizing DP PCA quantities.

Getting Started with dppca

Install dppca, explore the example datasets, prepare input data, allocate privacy budgets, and find tutorials and theory articles.

DP Loading Plots

Estimate private principal component directions, inspect their coefficients, and create vector, point, and heatmap loading plots.

DP Scree Plots

Estimate private scree values, inspect PVE, select clipped, PMWM, or Huber controls, and customize scree plots.

DP Score Plots

Estimate and plot private two-dimensional PCA score histograms, configure synthetic sampling, compare groups, and reuse directions.

DP PCA Visualization

Use vowel data to fit one grouped private PCA analysis, read its summary, and create scree, score, loading, variable, and biplot displays.

Theory

Background and mathematical methods for DP PCA visualization.

Principal Component Analysis

An introduction to principal component directions, scores, explained variance, and the main graphical representations of PCA.

Differentially Private PC Directions

Private principal component directions based on the spherical Kendall matrix, Gaussian perturbation, and loading plot visualization in dppca.

Differentially Private Eigenvalues

Theoretical foundations of private projected-variance estimation using clipped means, private modified winsorized means, and Huber means.

Differentially Private PC Scores

Mathematical construction and privacy accounting for two-dimensional private PCA score histograms, synthetic sampling, and grouped releases.

Differentially Private PCA Visualizations

How dppca combines private PC directions, projected-variance estimates, and score histograms to construct scree, loading, score, variable, and biplot visualizations.
